body_revisions.scope: Separate state refresh from repair of the object, then connect to the independent Argo CD experiment.
body_revisions.observation: Terraform refresh changes the binding while the file still contains outside. A normal apply restores alpha.

body_revisions.scope: Identify the explicit self-heal action that modifies the deployment, and contrast it with Terraform refresh.
body_revisions.observation: With the same Git revision, the independent Argo CD run reports the drift at two replicas before self-heal and restores one replica after it is enabled.
